context_sentence: They applied dropout between the dense layers to keep the network from overfitting the small training set.
article_text: The team's first model scored well on training data but poorly on new inputs. They applied dropout between the dense layers to keep the network from overfitting the small training set. After adding it, the gap between training and validation accuracy shrank noticeably.
check_notes: meaning 必须零背景可懂,不能用其它 ML 术语解释术语;dropout 无常见易混概念,distinction 应为空(测触发恰当性 = 不硬凑)。

context_sentence: Before MCP, every framework defined its tools with its own JSON Schema, and the fragmentation made them impossible to reuse across agents.
article_text: The Model Context Protocol was proposed to end tool-definition chaos. Before MCP, every framework defined its tools with its own JSON Schema, and the fragmentation made them impossible to reuse across agents. MCP standardizes on one shared format so any compatible agent can read the same tool description.
distinction_hint: 一份实际的 JSON 文档(填好的数据实例)——schema 是空白表格,document 是填好的一份
check_notes: meaning 不能用行话解释行话;distinction 应把 schema(表格)与实际 JSON 文档(实例)用同一情境区分开。

context_sentence: The runtime achieves high concurrency by interleaving thousands of tasks on just a handful of threads, even on a single core.
article_text: People assume speed comes from more cores. The runtime achieves high concurrency by interleaving thousands of tasks on just a handful of threads, even on a single core. Tasks take turns whenever one is waiting, so many appear to progress at once.
distinction_hint: parallelism(并行)——concurrency 是任务交替推进的结构,parallelism 是真的同时在多核上跑
check_notes: 经典易混对;distinction 必须命中 parallelism,且 related_terms 不得重复放 parallelism。

context_sentence: Because the endpoint is idempotent, the client can safely retry a failed request without risking a duplicate charge.
article_text: Network calls fail all the time, so retries must be safe. Because the endpoint is idempotent, the client can safely retry a failed request without risking a duplicate charge. Calling it once or five times leaves the account in the same state.
distinction_hint: immutable/‘只读’——idempotent 允许改变状态,但重复执行结果相同;不是‘不改变’
check_notes: 常被误解为‘不产生副作用/只读’;distinction 应澄清‘重复执行结果一致’≠‘不改变状态’。

context_sentence: Adding more workers raised throughput but did nothing for latency: each individual request still took the same 200 ms.
article_text: The scaling results surprised the team. Adding more workers raised throughput but did nothing for latency: each individual request still took the same 200 ms. They were serving more requests per second, but no single user waited any less.
distinction_hint: throughput(吞吐)——latency 是单次请求的等待时间,throughput 是单位时间处理量;句中两者同时出现
check_notes: 句子本身就并列了两者;distinction 必须用 throughput 区分,meaning 要抓‘单次等待时间’。

context_sentence: A conviction requires not just the wrongful act but mens rea — the guilty state of mind behind it.
article_text: Criminal liability has two halves. A conviction requires not just the wrongful act but mens rea — the guilty state of mind behind it. A person who genuinely could not have known the outcome may lack it, even if harm resulted.
distinction_hint: actus reus(犯罪行为)——mens rea 是‘犯罪心态’,actus reus 是‘犯罪行为’,两者共同构成犯罪
check_notes: 经典法律配对;distinction 命中 actus reus。meaning 用中文说清‘有罪的主观心态’。

context_sentence: Spilling hot coffee on a customer is a tort, not a crime: the remedy is compensation to the victim, not punishment by the state.
article_text: Not every wrong lands you in jail. Spilling hot coffee on a customer is a tort, not a crime: the remedy is compensation to the victim, not punishment by the state. The injured party, not a prosecutor, brings the claim.
distinction_hint: crime(犯罪)——tort 是民事侵权,救济是赔偿;crime 由国家追诉、施以惩罚;句中已点出对比
check_notes: distinction 应区分 tort(民事赔偿)vs crime(国家惩罚)。

context_sentence: The promise was unenforceable because it lacked consideration — the other side gave nothing in return.
article_text: A signed promise is not automatically a contract. The promise was unenforceable because it lacked consideration — the other side gave nothing in return. Courts look for a bargained-for exchange, not a one-way gift.
check_notes: 陷阱:polysemy。meaning 必须是合同法义(‘对价’/为换取承诺而付出的东西),不能是日常义(‘体贴/考虑’)。无强易混概念,distinction 留空。

context_sentence: The central bank's credibility rests on the public believing it will not inflate away its promises.
article_text: Monetary policy is as much about expectations as interest rates. The central bank's credibility rests on the public believing it will not inflate away its promises. Once people expect low inflation, they set wages accordingly, which helps keep it low.
distinction_hint: reputation(声誉)——reputation 是总体名声,credibility 特指‘是否相信你下一个承诺’
check_notes: 已知样例。related_terms 用 trust 作锚点,distinction 用 reputation——两者不得重复。

context_sentence: That the government ought to raise the minimum wage is a claim of normative economics, not a testable prediction.
article_text: Economists separate two kinds of statements. That the government ought to raise the minimum wage is a claim of normative economics, not a testable prediction. Whether a wage rise reduces employment, by contrast, is a factual question one can check against data.
distinction_hint: positive economics(实证经济学)——normative 谈‘应该如何’(价值判断),positive 谈‘事实如何’(可检验)
check_notes: distinction 必须对比 normative(应然)vs positive(实然)。

context_sentence: Deposit insurance can create moral hazard: banks take bigger risks because the losses fall on the insurer, not themselves.
article_text: Safety nets can backfire. Deposit insurance can create moral hazard: banks take bigger risks because the losses fall on the insurer, not themselves. When you are shielded from the downside, caution gets expensive to justify.
distinction_hint: adverse selection(逆向选择)——moral hazard 是‘签约后’行为改变;adverse selection 是‘签约前’信息不对称的筛选
check_notes: distinction 应区分 moral hazard(事后行为)vs adverse selection(事前筛选)。

context_sentence: The firm was solvent on paper yet failed from a lack of liquidity — its assets were real but couldn't be sold fast enough to cover the payment due.
article_text: A company can die with a healthy balance sheet. The firm was solvent on paper yet failed from a lack of liquidity — its assets were real but couldn't be sold fast enough to cover the payment due. Owning valuable buildings does not help if a bill is due today.
distinction_hint: solvency(偿付能力)——solvency 是资产是否够还债(长期),liquidity 是能否及时变现(短期);句中两者对照出现
check_notes: distinction 命中 solvency;meaning 抓‘能否快速变现’。

context_sentence: The enzyme acts as a catalyst, speeding the reaction without being consumed by it.
article_text: Cells rely on molecular helpers to run chemistry at body temperature. The enzyme acts as a catalyst, speeding the reaction without being consumed by it. The same molecule can assist the reaction over and over.
check_notes: 句子本身已点出关键特性;无需硬造易混概念,distinction 应留空(控制样例)。

context_sentence: Entropy is often glossed as 'disorder', but here it counts how many microscopic arrangements produce the same overall state.
article_text: Textbooks reach for a tidy metaphor. Entropy is often glossed as 'disorder', but here it counts how many microscopic arrangements produce the same overall state. A gas has high entropy because countless molecular configurations look identical from the outside.
distinction_hint: ‘disorder(混乱)’这一通俗说法——distinction 应纠正把 entropy 简单等同于‘乱’的误解
check_notes: 测‘纠正常见误解’型 distinction:vs 通俗的‘disorder’。

context_sentence: Patients given a placebo often improve simply because they believe they are being treated.
article_text: Belief has measurable effects on the body. Patients given a placebo often improve simply because they believe they are being treated. This is why serious trials compare a new drug against a dummy pill rather than against nothing.
distinction_hint: nocebo(反安慰剂)——placebo 因预期而好转,nocebo 因预期而恶化;是对称的反面
check_notes: 科普语境(非用药建议,符合产品范围)。distinction 命中 nocebo。

context_sentence: The compound killed the cancer cells in vitro, but whether it works inside a living body is another question entirely.
article_text: A promising lab result is only a first step. The compound killed the cancer cells in vitro, but whether it works inside a living body is another question entirely. Many drugs that shine in a dish fail once a whole organism is involved.
distinction_hint: in vivo(体内)——in vitro 是在试管/培养皿中,in vivo 是在活体内;句中已用‘living body’点出对照
check_notes: distinction 命中 in vivo;meaning 用中文说清‘在试管/离体环境中’。

context_sentence: For Popper, what makes a theory scientific is falsifiability — that some possible observation could prove it wrong.
article_text: Not every confident claim counts as science. For Popper, what makes a theory scientific is falsifiability — that some possible observation could prove it wrong. A theory compatible with every conceivable result explains nothing.
distinction_hint: verifiability(可证实性)——falsifiability 要求‘能被证伪’,verifiability 关注‘能被证实’;波普尔的关键转向
check_notes: distinction 区分‘可证伪’vs‘可证实’。

context_sentence: Gramsci argued that the ruling class holds power less through force than through hegemony — leading by consent, so its worldview feels like plain common sense.
article_text: Why do the governed so often accept their place? Gramsci argued that the ruling class holds power less through force than through hegemony — leading by consent, so its worldview feels like plain common sense. Domination becomes invisible when it looks like the natural order.
distinction_hint: coercion/单纯的‘统治(domination by force)’——hegemony 是通过‘同意’领导,而非靠强制
check_notes: distinction 区分‘靠同意的领导’vs‘靠强制的统治’。

context_sentence: Hegel's dialectic moves by drawing out the contradictions within an idea and resolving them into a higher one.
article_text: Hegel saw thought as restless. Hegel's dialectic moves by drawing out the contradictions within an idea and resolving them into a higher one. Each resolution then reveals new tensions, and the process begins again.
check_notes: 抽象概念但无高频易混对;distinction 留空。测 substance 的理解深度(讲清‘矛盾—扬弃’的运动)。

context_sentence: He met the news with a stiff upper lip, betraying nothing.
article_text: The telegram brought word that the ship was lost. He met the news with a stiff upper lip, betraying nothing. Only much later, alone in the study, did the weight of it finally show.
distinction_hint: poker face(扑克脸)——poker face 是为占优势而隐藏情绪;stiff upper lip 是以坚忍尊严承受苦难
check_notes: 已知样例(翻译型需求)。meaning 给语境化译义,不可直译;distinction 命中 poker face。

context_sentence: Her last day at the company she had built was bittersweet — pride in what she'd made, sorrow at leaving it behind.
article_text: Endings rarely come in a single color. Her last day at the company she had built was bittersweet — pride in what she'd made, sorrow at leaving it behind. She smiled at the send-off and blinked back tears in the same breath.
check_notes: 文学/情感词;无易混概念,distinction 留空。meaning 给语境化的中文译义(苦乐参半)。

context_sentence: Everyone discussed the budget cheerfully, ignoring the elephant in the room: half of them would be laid off by spring.
article_text: The meeting had a strange lightness to it. Everyone discussed the budget cheerfully, ignoring the elephant in the room: half of them would be laid off by spring. The one thing that mattered was the one thing no one would name.
check_notes: 习语;作为整体译义(众人回避、显而易见却无人提的问题)。无易混对,distinction 留空。

context_sentence: Serving the poor was not a side project for the order; it was their raison d'être.
article_text: The monastery ran a hospital, a school, and a soup kitchen. Serving the poor was not a side project for the order; it was their raison d'être. Strip that away and the community would have had no reason to exist at all.
check_notes: 外来语(法语)翻译型;meaning 给语境化中文(存在的根本理由)。无易混对,distinction 留空。

context_sentence: The tea room's rough, worn bowls embodied wabi-sabi — a beauty found in imperfection and impermanence.
article_text: Nothing in the room was polished or symmetrical. The tea room's rough, worn bowls embodied wabi-sabi — a beauty found in imperfection and impermanence. A crack repaired with gold was not hidden but celebrated.
distinction_hint: minimalism(极简主义)——两者都推崇简素,但 minimalism 求纯净秩序,wabi-sabi 珍视残缺与无常
check_notes: 外来语概念;distinction 区分 wabi-sabi(残缺无常之美)vs minimalism(纯净秩序)。

context_sentence: But this second model, trained only on synthetic data, failed to generalize.
article_text: The lab built two systems for the same task. Their first model learned from real customer logs and performed well. But this second model, trained only on synthetic data, failed to generalize. In the end they kept the first model in production and scrapped the other.
check_notes: 陷阱:'model' 在文中出现三次。必须锚定到被选中的那句(第二个、合成数据的 model),meaning 要反映‘用合成数据训练的那个’,而非首次出现的那个。distinction 留空。

context_sentence: In the region around the magnet, the field grows stronger the closer you get.
article_text: Iron filings sprinkled on paper trace invisible lines. In the region around the magnet, the field grows stronger the closer you get. Move far enough away and its pull becomes too weak to notice.
check_notes: 陷阱:polysemy。必须取物理义(磁场/场),不能是日常义(田野/领域)。distinction 留空。

context_sentence: I ditched the popular frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI) after burning weeks on abstraction layers that fought me more than helped.
article_text: Orchestration: I ditched the popular frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI) after burning weeks on abstraction layers that fought me more than helped. Now I run a flat skill-based system — each capability is an isolated module the agent can invoke. Less magic, way easier to debug.
distinction_hint: replaced(替换)——ditch 是彻底弃用、可能不换替代;replace 是换成别的。此处他确实转向自研,但重点在‘扔掉’
check_notes: 常见词压力测试。meaning ✓、distinction ✓(vs replaced)是价值所在;**substance 应简短或留空**——普通动词无机制可拆,若长篇复述含义即扣理解深度分;**related_terms 必须是更熟悉的近义词(如 dumped/dropped)或留空,绝不能是‘被 ditch 的对象’(frameworks / abstraction layers)**——那是句法宾语,不是锚点。用于抓‘对常见词硬凑 substance/anchors’的失败模式。
